title: envs values.yml
description: Values of the environment variables per profile and worktree, stored in .envs/values.yml.

uses.description: Profile used by each worktree, keyed by worktree name. A worktree that is not listed uses `default`.

profiles.description: Profiles by name. `default` applies to every worktree; the profile a worktree uses is applied on top of it.

defaults.description: Legacy form of profiles.default.defaults; `envs edit` migrates it.

additionalProperties.description: Default value of the environment variable.

envs.description: Legacy form of profiles.default.envs; `envs edit` migrates it.

additionalProperties.description: Values of one environment variable, keyed by worktree name.
Value of the environment variable in that worktree.

defaults.description: Default value of each environment variable, written to every worktree that uses the profile unless envs overrides it.

additionalProperties.description: Values of one environment variable, keyed by worktree name.
